dict.string: LanSend needs access to your local network to find your other devices and send files to them directly. For example, when you choose a photo and pick your Mac or iPhone in the device list, LanSend discovers that device on your Wi‑Fi and sends the photo straight to it, with no server in between.

LanSend needs access to your photo library so you can pick photos and videos to send to another device. For example, choose a video from your library and send it to your Mac: it goes straight to that device and is never uploaded anywhere.
